description: Legal practice management framework layer — Drizzle ORM schema for matters/parties/documents/time-entries/billing-rates/invoices, Node http REST routes, and decimal-safe invoice draft generation.

buildHints.whenToUse: Building a law-firm SaaS API that needs matter tracking, attorney time-keeping, content-addressed document retention, and billing. Supplies the full Drizzle schema, six REST endpoints, and decimal-safe invoice generation out of the box.
firstSteps: Copy .env.example to .env and set DATABASE_URL to a Postgres 15+ connection string.
Run `pnpm install` then `pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate` to create all tables.
Run `pnpm dev` — server starts on port 8102; verify with `curl http://localhost:8102/health`.
Seed a client row directly in the DB (or add POST /api/clients), then POST /api/matters with { clientId, matterNumber, title }.
Insert at least one billing_rates row for the attorney before drafting an invoice.
POST /api/matters/:id/time-entries with { attorneyId, workedAt (ISO), minutes (integer), narrative } to log time.
POST /api/matters/:id/invoice/draft aggregates all unbilled billable entries into a draft Invoice row.
Routes: GET /health · POST /api/matters · GET /api/matters/:id · POST /api/matters/:id/time-entries · GET /api/matters/:id/time-entries · POST /api/matters/:id/invoice/draft
gotchas: Time entries MUST be stored in minutes (positive integer), not fractional hours. Rounding 0.1h + 0.1h across 200 entries drifts real dollars.
Hourly rates MUST use integer cents — billing.ts uses decimal.js for all arithmetic. Never convert to float before arithmetic.
Documents are IMMUTABLE under retention obligations. Do NOT add UPDATE or DELETE endpoints for the documents table — amendments are new rows referencing the prior contentHash.
Attorney-client privilege: access control MUST be enforced at the matter level, not just the document level. Leaking matter title or party names to the wrong client is still a privilege breach.

Trust / IOLTA accounting is SEPARATE from the operating ledger — commingling is a bar-disciplinary offense. If this service handles trust funds it needs its own chart of accounts with explicit segregation.
Conflicts checking is NOT implemented — before opening a matter in production, check all party names against every prior matter including opposing parties.
Billable-hours rounding convention varies by firm (6-minute increments is common). Store raw minutes; apply firm rounding at invoice generation time inside billing.ts.
Retention: many jurisdictions require 5–7 years after matter closure. Soft-delete + lifecycle policy; never hard-delete document rows.
architectureNotes: Matter-centric schema: every party, document, time entry, and invoice belongs to a Matter. This mirrors the legal concept of 'matter' as the unit of work and the unit of privilege.
Documents are content-addressed: content_hash = sha256(bytes) is the primary identity. Replacing a document creates a new row; the old row is never mutated.
Time entries are immutable once invoiced — draftInvoice() sets invoice_id FK inside a transaction; callers cannot unset it.
Billing rates are time-bounded (effectiveAt). billing.ts resolves each entry to the rate effective at entry.workedAt so historical invoices stay accurate after a rate change.
Invoice draft runs in one DB transaction: aggregate unbilled entries → compute amounts via Decimal → insert Invoice → set invoice_id on each entry. Avoids double-billing on retry.
Data models: clients · attorneys · matters · parties · documents · billing_rates · invoices · time_entries. See src/db/schema.ts for full Drizzle column/index definitions.

placeholders.description: {{port}} is replaced with the numeric port from family defaults (8102). {{serviceName}} is replaced with the service name. After compose these are literal strings.
